description: A professional, extensible PHP 8.4 library for dice rolling in game applications with seeded randomness, comprehensive type safety, and statistical analysis capabilities.

PSR-4 autoloading configured for src/ and tests/
PHPUnit 11.x installed and configured
PHPStan level 9 configured for strict type checking
Directory structure: src/, tests/, docs/, examples/

userStories.title: Seeded Random Number Generator
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a seedable RNG engine so that I can reproduce and debug dice rolls consistently.
acceptanceCriteria: RandomEngine interface with seed(), next(), and reset() methods
Mt19937Engine implementation (Mersenne Twister) with custom seed
Seed can be set via constructor or setSeed() method
Same seed produces identical sequence of numbers
getSeed() method returns current seed for debugging
Full type declarations on all methods and properties
Unit tests verify deterministic behavior
Unit tests verify different seeds produce different sequences
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Core Die Class

acceptanceCriteria: Die class with sides property (minimum 2 sides)
roll() method using injected RandomEngine
Returns DieResult value object with value, timestamp, seed info
Supports standard dice (d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20, d100)
Immutable after construction
Full type declarations including readonly properties
Unit tests cover all standard die types
Unit tests verify roll results are within valid range
Unit tests verify seeded rolls are deterministic
